$comment: The sample church's sermon series (README.md, series.json). Each slot has two series: a year uses the first in even years and the second in odd years. The campaign series runs the four Sundays that end on Commitment Sunday and replaces any other series those weeks. Names are invented for the sample church.

new-year.$comment: Starts the first Sunday of January.

fall.$comment: Starts the second Sunday of September.
